best_rules_serialized.name: context_person_academic_titles
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches person names preceded by academic titles (Mag., Dr., Ing., etc.) including compound titles, hyphenated names, and multiple suffixes like LL.M., MBA, MAS, Bakk., etc.

best_rules_serialized.name: context_person_beschwerdesache
best_rules_serialized.description: Matches person names specifically appearing after 'Beschwerdesache' (case of complaint), stopping at commas or addresses.

best_rules_serialized.name: context_person_herr_combined
best_rules_serialized.description: Merged: Rules 9f6bdb14 and f810b83c have identical patterns and metrics; merging eliminates redundancy while preserving the high precision (0.83) of the 'Herr' pattern.
